digest.component_or_area: binding-store persistence and selective tickets-branch publication
propositions: Repository delegation must maintain clear ownership boundaries between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without blurring the seam.
Publication must stage only the existing five bridge-state files; unchanged passes create no commits and repository checkpoints never publish independently.
GET rotation, retired-first publication, and failure recovery semantics must preserve pre-extraction publication and recovery floors through held-out selective-publication suites.
ADR 0099 must record repository versus publication ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, rollback decisions, and explicit rejections of journal/format-migration approaches.
Repository failures must not cause unrelated tracker staging; repository checkpoints leave HEAD and index untouched while local files persist.
